note: Card values in A$ by grade. tg: rows come from the Slab Finder's TG benchmarks; others from PriceCharting (US$ x 1.4232). Edit or add entries freely: num = card number as printed (leading zeros dropped, or No.151 for old Japanese), words = name words that must all be in the title, keys = set words (any one must be in the title; empty = number is enough), first = 1st Edition only, rev = reverse/mirror only. slab = played-copy grading targets: low = typical low-grade (lowg) sale A$, mid = PSA 7 sale A$; the feed lists raw copies where grading clears fees.
